_about: Measured wind models for engine/orchestra.py, written by examples/production/cinematic/fit_winds.py (2026-11-26): per instrument, anchors = recorded notes (f0, dynamic 0-1, harmonic levels on a 1/6-octave grid 63 Hz x 2^(k/6), dB re the strongest harmonic) and an attack law t = a (f0/220)^b ms. Sources: University of Iowa MIS (ff) and VSCO-2-CE (CC0) brass layers; measurement only.
